notes.title: Update 2.0.18
notes.content:
Math Path Builder 2.0.18 is out!!!

    [list]
[*] A level editor and full server integration so you can upload, play and rate each others levels!
[*]     Hint system. Every 600s you can get a hint if you are stuck! (No need to watch ads for it, I hate ads)
[*]     Background themes that can be unlocked by progressing the generated levels. They can also be used in the level editor to give your author name and level name different colors.
[*]     A store where you can buy different background themes, if you want to support me. (Background themes are only visual effects)
[/list]
